summary.text: Mark Divitt is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 91, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Judd Lawler (R) is also running.
A software engineer, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he spent about forty years in the field.

paragraphs.text: Mark Divitt graduated from Miramonte High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Sonoma State University in 1985.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he began his career at Hewlett-Packard and spent about forty years as a software engineer and architect.
Divitt said he became involved in public life when he and his neighbors organized against a proposed power plant near his community, and that he later founded EcoInference.ai.
He listed clean water and air, addressing Iowa's cancer rates, and a statewide pause on new large-scale AI data centers among his key messages.
